fields.statement: QA at 19080e6f6: built rhiza to a scratch path and ran a scratch workflow (agent step build with until_when=done and a handback template, command step check failing once with on.fail=handback:build) under a fake rex and a fake live claude that reports Stop, runs rhiza session done, then blocks until rex send types the hand-back. Fixed binary: the run succeeded via 'rejoining session', the raw session record at the start of visit 2 had no done mark, and the final mark came from the second, fresh session done. Control with the merge-base binary (abd7d1a89): visit 2's record still held visit 1's done mark and the final mark was that stale one. Failure cases: rex send failing ('rex could not type', run failed) and a step with no handback template ('step build sets no handback template', no message written) both left visit 1's done mark in place. Scoped tests: go test ./internal/api -run 'TestHandbackDeliver|TestSessionDone|TestSessionMessage' ok; go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-handback|ship-change-one-ci)$' ok.
